title: Headless Anywhere I Wander (VTechatticup), the fail: VTechatticup 10 as in anywhere-i-wander, then Renolds killed (VTechatticup 110)

actions.text: Path: as anywhere-i-wander to 'VTechatticup 10'; then Renolds killed (the quest script sets VTechatticup 110 once he is dead). Kill stands in for each fight, by the player; travel is move_player.

A Legion explorer from Nelson calls StartConversation on the player as its cell loads (nvNelsonExplorerBarkSCRIPT; the engine starts it at once, StartConversation's walk-up is a stand-in). The player answers peacefully (Topic009, then 010: go before the Decanus).
